notes.title: Demo v3.0.0: Online Multiplayer Mode, Import Custom Skin
notes.content:
Demo v3.0.0: Online Multiplayer Mode, Import Custom Skin

The demo is updated just now! You can try it with your friends now! (or rage gaming with themːsteammockingː

Online Multiplayer Mode

 Public Server: You can create a public lobby from the multiplayer menu. Public servers will appear on the server list. Everyone can join.
 Private Server: You can create a private lobby from the multiplayer menu. Your friends can join the server through the Steam friends system.
 This server connection is peer-to-peer. The connection status depends on the host player.


Import Custom Skin

 You can create any number of custom skins from the skin menu.
 Please import a square image in PNG or JPG format.
 Custom skin is not working in multiplayer mode.

notes.title: Demo v2.0.1
notes.content:
Fix traditional Chinese translation and reduce the difficulty of two objects.

The update includes:

Filled in the missing translation for traditional Chinese.
One of the moving triangles is not moving now.
The long red spline is bigger now.

notes.title: Demo: Updated to V2.0.0
notes.content:
Trial version: updated to V2.0.0

A large number of changes: changes in operating modes, changes in music and sound effects, new modeling system, new tutorial levels, and a large number of interactive objects


The protagonist's elasticity is increased, making rebound easier.
 Added rebound jumping function. You can jump higher by bouncing at the right time.
Added various control-related settings.
 Change the occurrence of music sound effects.
New tutorial level
 Adding many shapes will only change the appearance.
Added host controller function. (Not fully tested basically it can be played through the controller function of STEAM)
Add a music box object to relax stress.
Add cat meow.


The demo version's game length is maintained.

notes.title: Progress Update & Upcoming Playtest Invitation
notes.content:
I am excited to say the game has evolved a lot.
​Many new things:

Six times the game levels
Skin Menu
Over 100 normal skins and 30 secret Skins
Many secret paths
Optimization
Removed some annoying voice
Many sound effects to better immersive
Bouncy control
And, of course, fix a lot of bugs

The first version of the whole game is nearly finished. 

​Before launching this game on STEAM, I hope to have more playtests on the whole game or demo 2.0.
​I enable the release of the playtest option soon.
Please feel free to comment if you have ANYTHING you want to say.

The playtest period should be around 1 December 2023 to 31 December 2023.

Finally, thanks a lot for playing this game. I am so happy I saw some gamers post the gameplay on YouTube or Twitch. It surprised me that I saw Korean, Japanese, Taiwanese, French, and American gamers playing my game. I will try my best to improve this, so let me know if there is any problem. ːsteamhappyː
